description: Configurable risk keywords and regex patterns for Stage 2 gating and consumer risk scoring

auto_renewal.name: Auto-Renewal & Recurring Billing
auto_renewal.reason: Automatic renewal term without affirmative consent or explicit prior billing notice.
auto_renewal.suggested_action: Require affirmative opt-in and ensure cancellation can be executed within 48 hours without penalty.

penalty_fees.name: Penalties, Liquidated Damages & Hidden Charges
penalty_fees.reason: Imposes pre-fixed damages, cancellation penalties, hidden fees, or non-refundable forfeiture.
penalty_fees.suggested_action: Verify under Section 74 Indian Contract Act: penalties exceeding reasonable loss are void/unenforceable.

unilateral_change.name: Unilateral Contract & Price Modifications
unilateral_change.reason: Permits service provider to unilaterally modify pricing, features, or obligations without notice.
unilateral_change.suggested_action: Require a minimum 30-day notice and right to terminate without penalty upon material changes.

liability_limitation.name: Liability Exemption & Cap
liability_limitation.reason: Restricts customer remedies or disclaims vendor liability for standard negligence or breach.
liability_limitation.suggested_action: Ensure liability cannot be excluded for statutory product/service defects under Consumer Protection Act 2019.

legal_recourse.name: Restriction on Legal Proceedings & Jurisdiction
legal_recourse.reason: Deprives consumer of jurisdiction in local consumer forums or forces binding unilateral dispute venues.
legal_recourse.suggested_action: Section 28 Indian Contract Act voids agreements restricting legal proceedings. Consumer forum rights cannot be waived.

restraint.name: Restraint of Trade & Non-Compete
restraint.reason: Restricts trade, profession, or lawful business. Strictly void under Section 27 of ICA 1872.
restraint.suggested_action: Remove post-termination trade restrictions entirely as they are void ab initio under Indian law.

short_notice.name: Unfair Short Notice Window
short_notice.reason: Imposes overly narrow time window for consumer response, cancellation, or dispute.
short_notice.suggested_action: Provide reasonable notice periods (at least 15-30 days) for consumer action.

money_signals.name: Financial Charges & Penalties Near Monetary Values
money_signals.reason: Explicit monetary charges, fines, or fees linked directly to consumer liability.
money_signals.suggested_action: Scrutinize exact monetary obligations against the advertised service cost.

real_estate_risk.name: Real Estate, Land & Property Risk Clauses
real_estate_risk.reason: Exposes buyer/lessee to property title defects, possession delays, hidden CAM charges, or forfeiture of booking amount under RERA & Transfer of Property Act.
real_estate_risk.suggested_action: Verify title search report, encumbrance certificate, RERA registration, and cap builder delay compensation reciprocity.

loan_risk.name: Loan, Startup Loan & Financial Agreement Risk Clauses
loan_risk.reason: Exposes borrower/guarantor to penal compound interest, immediate loan acceleration, personal guarantee invocation, or cross-default triggers under RBI guidelines.
loan_risk.suggested_action: Negotiate cure periods (minimum 15-30 days), remove personal guarantees if institutional, and eliminate prepayment/foreclosure penalties pursuant to RBI directives.

shareholder_risk.name: Shareholders, Startup Equity & Founders Agreement Risk Clauses
shareholder_risk.reason: Allows investor vetoes, forced share sale at nominal valuation (drag-along / bad leaver), punitive full-ratchet dilution, or founder equity forfeiture under Companies Act 2013.
shareholder_risk.suggested_action: Ensure broad-based weighted average rather than full-ratchet anti-dilution; cap drag-along with floor valuation and mutual consent; clearly define good vs bad leaver.

ip_risk.name: Intellectual Property, Licensing & Tech Transfer Risk Clauses
ip_risk.reason: Forces broad transfer or perpetual exclusive licensing of inventions/works without residual rights or adequate royalty under Copyright Act 1957 & Patent Act 1970.
ip_risk.suggested_action: Retain pre-existing background IP, restrict assignment strictly to paid deliverables, and exclude future independent innovations.

contract_general_risk.name: Commercial Contracts & Unfair Standard Terms
contract_general_risk.reason: Excludes consequential liability, forces one-sided indemnification, or imposes unilateral variation without counterparty consent under Indian Contract Act 1872.
contract_general_risk.suggested_action: Require mutual indemnification caps tied to contract value and ensure dispute resolution remains subject to Indian judicial forums.

employment_risk.name: Employment & HR Contract Risk Terms
employment_risk.reason: Imposes unlawful employment bonds, salary/gratuity withholding, or post-termination trade restrictions void under Section 27 Indian Contract Act.
employment_risk.suggested_action: Employment bonds are unenforceable beyond actual training expenses. Section 27 strictly bars post-employment non-compete covenants.
